title: Post-Rock
tagline: Rock instrumentation used for long-form texture, dynamics, and instrumental storytelling.
summary: Post-rock uses familiar rock instruments in ways that emphasize texture, timbre, and gradual development over conventional verse-chorus songwriting. Many artists build instrumental pieces from quiet beginnings toward large dynamic peaks, while others use electronics and unusual structures. The style grew through independent scenes and remains diverse in approach.

pillars.name: Talk Talk
pillars.why: Talk Talk's later albums used rock instrumentation for spacious, exploratory compositions that influenced post-rock.

pillars.name: Slint
pillars.why: Slint's quiet-loud dynamics and unusual structures became an influential reference for post-rock bands.

pillars.name: Tortoise
pillars.why: Tortoise combined instrumental rock with electronic and jazz ideas in a distinctive Chicago sound.
